AssistantQueueRequest.description: A message for the chat's queue. `id` becomes the turn's request id when it starts.
AssistantQueueRequest.title: AssistantQueueRequest

AssistantSelection.description: The Desktop's assistant choice, readable by Remote, which cannot open Settings.
AssistantSelection.title: AssistantSelection

AssistantSelectionRequest.description: The one assistant choice Desktop Settings and both composers share.
AssistantSelectionRequest.title: AssistantSelectionRequest

BudgetReadout.description: Need and have for a picker badge. The sentence stays on ``message``.
BudgetReadout.title: BudgetReadout

ChunkedFastCell.description:
One kept cell the local budget runs in overlapping windows, not one pass.

The picker tells the user it takes longer. ``windows`` is the job's window count and
``window_frames`` the pixel frames of one window. A cell that loads in a single pass never
appears. Same ``audio`` split as the warned cells (A2V rides its own grid).
ChunkedFastCell.title: ChunkedFastCell

CreateAudioToVideoParams.description: Public non-media A2V inputs; the server derives inference frames from audio.
CreateAudioToVideoParams.title: CreateAudioToVideoParams

CreateCustomLoraRequest.description: ``inputs`` carries the optional Start Frame. With it the run is image to video. Without it, text to video.
CreateCustomLoraRequest.title: CreateCustomLoraRequest

CustomLoraImportRequest.description: Add a custom LoRA from exactly one source: a local file path or a URL.
CustomLoraImportRequest.title: CustomLoraImportRequest

CustomLoraItem.description:
One saved custom LoRA.

The desktop list puts the cover file path in ``cover_url``. The phone list replaces that
path with a signed URL, so a paired phone never receives a filesystem path.
CustomLoraItem.title: CustomLoraItem

CustomLoraLinkInfoRequest.description: Check whether a URL is an accepted Custom LoRA link and read its Hugging Face model card.
CustomLoraLinkInfoRequest.title: CustomLoraLinkInfoRequest

CustomLoraLinkInfoResponse.description: Link validity and suggestions from a model card. The user checks and edits them. Nothing is saved.
CustomLoraLinkInfoResponse.title: CustomLoraLinkInfoResponse

CustomLoraParams.description:
Create-body params for a custom LoRA run.

The client sends the custom LoRA id + scale, never a filesystem path. Create stores
``loras: [{ ref: "", scale, displayName, customLoraId }]`` and execute hydrates the
weights path (see ``make_custom_lora_resolver``). ``aspectRatio`` includes ``auto`` only
when the run has a start frame (resolved from the start frame at execute); a run without
one rejects ``auto``.
CustomLoraParams.title: CustomLoraParams

CustomLoraRestoreRequest.description:
Put the weights of a saved LoRA back. A `source_path` copies that file. Without it, the
weights are fetched again from the saved link.
CustomLoraRestoreRequest.title: CustomLoraRestoreRequest

DashboardSelection.description: Activity Dashboard view. An empty list means Any.
DashboardSelection.title: DashboardSelection

DownloadSpec.description:
HF download location for a catalog item.

``variants`` is always non-empty. The first entry is the default checkpoint
(preferred for generation / omit-``variant_id`` downloads). See the comment on
``LoraCatalogHandler`` listing helpers.
DownloadSpec.title: DownloadSpec

DownloadVariant.description: One downloadable weights file under a catalog item (e.g. strong vs light).
DownloadVariant.title: DownloadVariant

DroppedFastAspectCell.description:
One anchor-kept cell a wider shape cannot run, with its refusal.

The grid (``fps_to_durations`` + ``dropped_cells``) is priced at the 16:9
anchor: a kept duration runs at 16:9. Only a wider frame (21:9 today) can
exceed the anchor, so these rows name exactly those (cell, shape) pairs —
same refusal Generate would return — for disabled-with-tooltip aspect
pickers. Never emitted for the anchor itself or for an anchor-dropped cell.
DroppedFastAspectCell.title: DroppedFastAspectCell

DroppedFastCell.description:
One static grid cell the budget withheld, with its refusal to show.

Kept + dropped reconstruct the full grid for disabled-with-tooltip
pickers. ``message`` is backend-composed (same builder as the 422s), so
list-time and request-time refusals read identically. ``audio`` selects
the A2V matrix, whose durations differ from the plain one.
DroppedFastCell.title: DroppedFastCell

DroppedIcLoraDuration.description:
One duration option the list-time budget withheld, with its refusal.

Advisory: list-time filtering previews a mid-size canvas without the user
image, so a dropped duration may still pass on a small source (generate
re-decides on real pixels). ``options`` stays filtered; kept + dropped
reconstruct the catalog grid for tooltip pickers.
DroppedIcLoraDuration.title: DroppedIcLoraDuration

EditPreflightCandidate.description:
One resolution tier the UI displays, echoed back by key.

``width``/``height`` None selects the source size ("original"); otherwise
both must be set. The backend resolves each exactly like a create's
``params.resolution`` (1080p cap, then the ÷32 snap), so verdicts match
what Generate would do.
EditPreflightCandidate.title: EditPreflightCandidate

EditPreflightCell.description:
Verdict for one (candidate, duration) cell. ``ok`` means Generate would
enqueue it in the echoed mode. An ok cell admitted on a bet carries the bet
line as ``message``; a failing cell carries the exact refusal Generate
would return.
EditPreflightCell.title: EditPreflightCell

EditPreflightRequest.description:
Advisory per-cell verdicts for Home retake/extend pickers.

``durations`` always includes the smallest selectable duration (extend
presets, retake minimum) so every candidate has an exact resolution-level
verdict; callers add the durations they display (extend presets, retake
current selection) for exact per-cell messages. ``startTime`` only affects
retake windowing, ``mode`` only extend stitching; both default so each
feature sends what it needs.
EditPreflightRequest.title: EditPreflightRequest

EditPreflightResolution.description:
Per-candidate summary. ``width``/``height`` is the resolved encode size.

``maxDurationSeconds`` is the longest duration that passes at this size,
floored to 0.5s for slider clamps; 0 when even the smallest requested
duration fails. Authoritative per-cell verdicts live in ``cells`` — this
row never overrides them.
EditPreflightResolution.title: EditPreflightResolution

EditPreflightResponse.description: Path-free (asset dims + verdicts only), so the Remote router reuses it.
EditPreflightResponse.title: EditPreflightResponse

EnhancePromptRequest.description:
Regular-LoRA, IC-LoRA, and built-in conditioning-type selection are mutually exclusive UI
surfaces — a request never carries more than one of loraCatalogIds/customLoraIds/icLoraId/conditioningType.
EnhancePromptRequest.title: EnhancePromptRequest

ExtendParams.description:
Queued Home/Remote extend.

``resolution`` omitted keeps the source size. Either way the picture is
capped at the local 1080p cell. The model encodes a black-bar letterbox
up to the next multiple of 32, and the stitch crops back to this picture.
ExtendParams.title: ExtendParams

FastCellAsk.description:
One Fast grid cell's ask, kept or withheld.

The ask is the shape the budget picks (``windows`` 1 is one pass). ``alternative`` is the
other shape's ask, sent only where a Brave form offers the choice, so a shape the form
shows is always one create runs.
FastCellAsk.title: FastCellAsk

FeatureFlags.description: Dev feature flags, persisted in feature_flags.json. Adding a flag = one field here.
FeatureFlags.title: FeatureFlags

FeatureFlagsPatch.description: Partial update: only the fields present in the body are applied.
FeatureFlagsPatch.title: FeatureFlagsPatch

FeatureRenderCell.description: Retake, extend, or one IC-LoRA recipe. `duration_s` is the edited span, or the output length for IC-LoRA.
FeatureRenderCell.title: FeatureRenderCell

FpsRenderCell.description: One render cell limited to a single frame rate. The pooled `render` list has no fps.
FpsRenderCell.title: FpsRenderCell

GenerationRisk.description:
Create-time snapshot of the bet a Brave job took.

Stored privately as spec["_risk"] (no store migration), promoted to this
typed field on every read. Drives the queue badge and the failure backstop
copy. An `over` tier also waives a later memory miss at execute. An
`unmeasured` tier does not. `over_gib`/`over_ram_gb` mirror the dropped-
cell figure semantics; `message` is the snapshotted tier line.
GenerationRisk.title: GenerationRisk

GenerationSeed.description: The seed every generate surface shares. `seed` is the next seed to use.
GenerationSeed.title: GenerationSeed

GenerationSeedUpdate.description: Partial update: a client can flip the lock without touching the seed.
GenerationSeedUpdate.title: GenerationSeedUpdate

IcLoraAutoSinglePass.description: Auto runs the whole clip in one pass.
IcLoraAutoSinglePass.title: IcLoraAutoSinglePass

IcLoraAutoWindowed.description: Auto runs the clip in chunks of ``frames`` frames.
IcLoraAutoWindowed.title: IcLoraAutoWindowed

IcLoraCatalogItem.description:
IC-LoRA — base plus IC-specific preprocessing / controls / default settings.

IC-LoRAs always take a driving image/video; `input` is required in practice (the base
field is optional for plain LoRAs). Enforced by the validator below, so handlers can rely
on it being present.
IcLoraCatalogItem.title: IcLoraCatalogItem

IcLoraCellFit.description:
How long a clip one output cell fits on this machine.

``max_frames`` is the longest clip, in frames at the output rate, whose job loads. 0 when none
does. ``full`` is a clip at the input cap.
IcLoraCellFit.title: IcLoraCellFit

IcLoraPreflightCell.description:
Verdict for one duration. ``message``/``code`` are None when ``ok``;
otherwise the exact refusal Generate would return for this input.
IcLoraPreflightCell.title: IcLoraPreflightCell

IcLoraPreflightRequest.description:
Advisory verdicts for a catalog IC-LoRA input before Generate.

Mirrors the generate probe check (source pixels → output canvas → budget)
without preprocessing or loading weights. ``durations`` lists the seconds
to verdict for image-input entries; video-input entries transform the
whole clip, so requested durations are ignored and one cell at the clip
length is returned. Sizing overrides mirror the generate request (None
keeps the entry default); ``fps_override`` is intentionally absent —
generate ignores it on the catalog probe path, and preflight must agree.
IcLoraPreflightRequest.title: IcLoraPreflightRequest

IcLoraPreflightResponse.description: Source dims + verdicts only; the input path is never echoed.
IcLoraPreflightResponse.title: IcLoraPreflightResponse

IcLoraPreflightSource.description:
Probed source dims. ``frames`` is the snapped clip length for video
inputs; images have no source frames, so it rides None there.
IcLoraPreflightSource.title: IcLoraPreflightSource

IcLoraRecipeMemoryRequest.description:
Memory advice for a Home video recipe, before and after a clip is picked.

``cells`` are the output cells the form offers. Without ``source`` each is priced for a 16:9
clip of that size. ``resolution`` is the selected cell, priced for ``source`` when given.
IcLoraRecipeMemoryRequest.title: IcLoraRecipeMemoryRequest

IcLoraRecipeMemorySource.description: The picked clip: its file size and its frames at the output rate.
IcLoraRecipeMemorySource.title: IcLoraRecipeMemorySource

IcLoraSheetParams.description: Params of an image-list recipe (Ingredients). An omitted ``fps`` is the catalog rate.
IcLoraSheetParams.title: IcLoraSheetParams

IcLoraTilePreflightRequest.description:
Advisory verdict per tile size and per window for a recipe create.

The body is the create body. Each requested tile size replaces its ``tilingSize``, each
requested maximum chunk length replaces its ``maxWindowFrames``, and each requested carry replaces its
``carryFrames``. The other choice of the body stays. ``standard`` is the tile of the
catalog entry. An empty prompt is accepted here. Create still refuses one. The response
also gives the carry, window and tile the run uses when the body omits them.
IcLoraTilePreflightRequest.title: IcLoraTilePreflightRequest

IcLoraTilePreflightResponse.description: Verdicts only. The input is never echoed.
IcLoraTilePreflightResponse.title: IcLoraTilePreflightResponse

IcLoraTiling.description:
Tile size of a catalog IC-LoRA, and an optional fixed temporal window.

``long_side`` and ``short_side`` are given for a landscape canvas. A portrait canvas
swaps them (Refine Details card: "1024x576, or 576x1024 portrait").

``window_frames`` is set when the LoRA drifts over a longer clip (Restore: past 97
frames detail is lost and colour drifts). A clip longer than the window always runs
in windows of this length. None leaves the choice to the job budget.

``adaptive_window`` leaves the window to the job budget for a LoRA that has no measured
drift length (Refine Details). The budget picks the longest window that fits, up to the cap
of the resolution (``ic_lora_adaptive_window``). It excludes ``window_frames``, because a
fixed window chunks every longer clip. ``max_window_frames`` is the run's own maximum
for it. None keeps the cap of the resolution.

``carry_frames`` is the part of a window that the next window re-renders and pins at
its start. It needs a ``window_frames`` or an ``adaptive_window``. None keeps
``DEFAULT_CARRY_FRAMES``. ``carry_pinned`` is set when the run chose the carry. An adaptive
run that did not is on Auto carry: ``carry_frames`` is then the longest carry that Auto may
use, and the job budget picks the carry that is safest (``ic_lora_auto_carry``).

``overlap_fraction`` is the share of a tile that the next tile covers again. A smaller
share means fewer tiles per step, and a faster run with a higher risk of seams.

``max_output_long_side`` and ``max_output_short_side`` raise the spatial cap of the
job for this LoRA. The transformer sees one tile at a time, so the output can be
larger than the local 1080p cell. None keeps that cell.
IcLoraTiling.title: IcLoraTiling

IcLoraTilingDefaults.description:
What Auto runs when the request omits a tiling control.

``carryFrames`` is the Auto carry. ``overlapFraction`` is the Auto tile overlap of the LoRA.
``auto`` is the Auto chunk length, picked from the clip and the resolution. It is None when
Auto is refused: the cells carry the refusal.
IcLoraTilingDefaults.title: IcLoraTilingDefaults

IcLoraTrackParams.description:
Params of the Motion Track recipe. An omitted ``fps`` is the catalog rate.

There is no ``aspectRatio``: create takes the closest ratio from the image.
IcLoraTrackParams.title: IcLoraTrackParams

IcLoraVideoRecipeParams.description: Create-body params of a video recipe.
IcLoraVideoRecipeParams.title: IcLoraVideoRecipeParams

ImageGenerationStatusResponse.description: Which image providers can run now. A blocker is the code create would refuse with.
ImageGenerationStatusResponse.title: ImageGenerationStatusResponse

ImageToVideoParams.description: Non-media image-to-video params stored on a generation row.
ImageToVideoParams.title: ImageToVideoParams

JobMemoryAsk.description:
What one job asks of the memory the gate compares.

``ask_gib`` is the figure admission compares against ``MemoryCapacity.capacity_gib``, rounded
up to 0.001 GiB, so a meter drawn from it never shows an over job as fitting. ``windows`` is
1 for a single pass. ``tight`` is the gate's own tight-fit flag. The band is sent on
``estimate`` asks only: one ask per Fast grid point and aspect makes this the bulk of the
specs payload. ``risk`` is sent on ``FastCellAsk.alternative`` when the alternative pass
shape is an ``over`` or ``unmeasured`` bet.
JobMemoryAsk.title: JobMemoryAsk

KeyframeInput.description: CamelCase of LTXV keyframe-edit `{image_uri, frame_index, strength}`.
KeyframeInput.title: KeyframeInput

KeyframeRef.description: One still on the timeline. An asset id, never a path.
KeyframeRef.title: KeyframeRef

KeyframesParams.description:
Non-media params of a Home Keyframes job. Several stills guide one clip.

The keyframes need a known length, so ``duration`` cannot be ``None``. A blank prompt
is refused: the generate request takes a blank one only with a start image.
KeyframesParams.title: KeyframesParams

LTXOfferingCapabilitiesSpec.description: Feature flags for one local model or API pipeline. Pixel maps stay backend-only.
LTXOfferingCapabilitiesSpec.title: LTXOfferingCapabilitiesSpec

LTXVideoGenerationAspectSpec.description: Per-aspect kept grids and cell annotations priced at that ratio's real canvas.
LTXVideoGenerationAspectSpec.title: LTXVideoGenerationAspectSpec

LoraCatalogItem.description: Base catalog entry — used as-is for a plain LoRA.
LoraCatalogItem.title: LoraCatalogItem

LoraRecipeInputs.description:
Start frame for an i2v LoRA recipe. t2v recipes omit this object.

``endFrame`` is only valid for recipes that require it (Transition).
LoraRecipeInputs.title: LoraRecipeInputs

LoraRecipeParams.description:
Create-body params for a LoRA recipe.

The client sends the catalog id + scale of the recipe's adapter, never a
filesystem ``ref``. Create stores ``loras: [{ ref: "", scale, catalogId }]``;
execute hydrates the installed path (see ``make_recipe_lora_resolver``).
``prompt`` is the raw user scene; the recipe's prompt scaffold is applied at
execution time. ``aspectRatio`` includes ``auto`` for i2v recipes (resolved
from the start frame at execute); t2v recipes reject ``auto``.
LoraRecipeParams.title: LoraRecipeParams

MemoryCapacity.description:
The figure every ``FastCellAsk`` is compared against.

``gpu`` is total VRAM (list time gates on total). ``mac`` is the MPS pool macOS recommends
for this Mac, which is the whole allowance video may use. None when the backend compared
nothing (unknown VRAM, unsupported process).
MemoryCapacity.title: MemoryCapacity

MotionPath.description: The path the Motion Track dot follows. Each segment is a cubic Bézier.
MotionPath.title: MotionPath

MotionPathPoint.description: A path anchor in frame-normalized coordinates. Handles are offsets from the anchor.
MotionPathPoint.title: MotionPathPoint

MpsMemoryResponse.description: Read-only Apple Silicon MPS memory snapshot, MiB. Fields are None off MPS.
MpsMemoryResponse.title: MpsMemoryResponse

OutpaintPads.description:
Per-edge pixels to add around the source video (extend-only, so all ≥ 0).

The +100% cap (each ≤ the source's axis size) needs the source dimensions, so it's enforced
in `_outpaint_canvas`, not here.
OutpaintPads.title: OutpaintPads

PromptEnhancerStatusResponse.description: Availability for the Explore Enhance control. Does not expose API keys or paths.
PromptEnhancerStatusResponse.title: PromptEnhancerStatusResponse

PromptTemplateSpec.description:
A fixed prompt structure a LoRA/IC-LoRA requires verbatim (e.g. a two-part
"Reference shows X. Edited shows Y." restore template, or crossview's enum-constrained
camera vocabulary). `template` contains `{name}` placeholders; each must have a matching
entry in `placeholders`. A degenerate template with no placeholders (e.g. "upscale") is a
fixed, non-generated prompt.
PromptTemplateSpec.title: PromptTemplateSpec

QueueProgress.description: Live progress for the persisted active queue entry.
QueueProgress.title: QueueProgress

ReplacedWindow.description: Seconds ``start`` to ``end`` of a source video that the job replaces (a Retake selection).
ReplacedWindow.title: ReplacedWindow

RetakeRequestParams.description: New retakes only: specs queued before the cap still parse as ``RetakeParams``.
RetakeRequestParams.title: RetakeRequestParams

TargetResolution.description:
Desired output resolution for a local generation. The backend corrects it to the
nearest valid size (snapped down to a multiple of 32, never above the source).
TargetResolution.title: TargetResolution

TextToImageParams.description: Create-body params. An omitted provider resolves from the settings at create time.
TextToImageParams.title: TextToImageParams

TextToVideoParams.description: Non-media text-to-video params stored on a generation row.
TextToVideoParams.title: TextToVideoParams

UiPreferences.description: The user settings that change what a form shows. Read-only, so Remote may read them.
UiPreferences.title: UiPreferences

WarnedFastAspectCell.description:
One kept (cell, wider shape) pair carrying a warning tier. Same
contract as WarnedFastCell; aspect pickers read this, the
resolution/fps/duration pickers never do.
WarnedFastAspectCell.title: WarnedFastAspectCell

WarnedFastCell.description:
One kept grid cell carrying a warning tier: a tight fit, or a Brave bet
(over budget or untested) the echoed mode admits.

Kept + warned render the full grid for warned-with-tooltip pickers:
``fps_to_durations`` stays the kept set, this list marks the risky subset.
``headroom_gib`` is set on tight cells only.
``message`` is backend-composed, same builder as the create annotation, so
the picker tooltip and the queue badge read identically.
WarnedFastCell.title: WarnedFastCell
